Question 9

The function h(x) is continuous and twice-differentiable for all x. The graph y=h″(x) is shown above. At what value(s) of x does h(x) have a point of inflection?

a
x=−1.5, x=1, and x=4
b
x=1
c
x=−1.5 and x=4
d
x=−3 and x=1
e
x=−3
